title: Manual Cloudron deploy and ship-gate workflow
summary: Cloudron deploy is operator-triggered only. Cursor agents follow a ship-gate: ask after CI, ask to deploy after merge, verify Change Log hubs, then ask whether to create a GitHub Release.
changes: Stop auto-deploy on green main; Deploy MyAPES Core to Cloudron runs only on workflow_dispatch.
Add ship-gate agent rule and skill with next-actions menus for merge, deploy, changelog hubs, and GitHub Release.
Document that the app Change Log Hub updates from releases.json on the same Cloudron deploy, and that sibling website changelogs need an explicit operator ask.
version_rationale: Patch release: changes how operators and agents trigger deploy and release without changing application product features for end users.
validation: DeploymentAuthenticationContractTest asserts deploy-cloudron.yml uses workflow_dispatch and does not use workflow_run.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Sibling APES website Change Log Hubs are not updated automatically by this deploy; operators must approve those updates separately.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. To restore auto-deploy behaviour, reintroduce the workflow_run trigger on Deploy MyAPES Core to Cloudron.
provenance: Defined by the ship-gate manual deploy and GitHub Release workflow for MyAPES Account issue #167 and pull request #168.
